title: EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P1-4K6-S2 (4.6 kW single-phase hybrid)

items.question: Which circuits receive power through the HD-P1-4K6-S2 BACKUP connection?
items.answer: The BACKUP connection supplies the backup loads. In the three-inverter cascade diagram, each inverter's BACKUP output feeds a backup load.
items.question_de: Welche Stromkreise hängen beim HD-P1-4K6-S2 am BACKUP-Anschluss?
items.answer_de: Der BACKUP-Anschluss versorgt die Backup-Lasten. Im Kaskadenschaltplan für drei Wechselrichter speist der BACKUP-Ausgang jedes Wechselrichters eine Backup-Last.

items.question: How many of these inverters can be cascaded?
items.answer: A maximum of three EF HD-P1-(3K/3K68/4K6/5K/5K75/6K)-S2 inverters can be cascaded.
items.question_de: Wie viele dieser Wechselrichter können kaskadiert werden?
items.answer_de: Es können maximal drei EF HD-P1-(3K/3K68/4K6/5K/5K75/6K)-S2-Wechselrichter kaskadiert werden.

items.question: Is the IOT dongle required?
items.answer: The EcoFlow IOT-Dongle ESS must be configured.
items.answer_de: Der EcoFlow IOT-Dongle ESS muss konfiguriert werden.
items.reason: Question asks whether the IOT dongle is required; answer only states it 'must be configured', which is a different claim and does not answer the requirement question. Citation carries 'Muss konfiguriert werden', not a mandatory-installation statement.
